IMF Warns of Financial Risks from AI Bubble and High Government Debt

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has warned that the threat of an AI share price crash could put global financial stability at risk due to high valuations and debt within the sector. The IMF is also urging governments to rebuild financial buffers, citing rising borrowing costs and high debt levels. These concerns, alongside ongoing wars, are expected to dominate the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok.
